import os
p='/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-2/play/users/u044/system/state/workspace/programs/task-7166d46d.py'
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    """Move every non-background cell down one row; background fills the vacated row."""
    from collections import Counter
    background = Counter(cell for row in grid for cell in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    output = [[background] * width for _ in range(height)]
    for r in range(height - 1):
        for c in range(width):
            if grid[r][c] != background:
                output[r + 1][c] = grid[r][c]
    return output
'''
# validate demo behavior based on rule
